agent_explanation: Single head-on collision with disparate masses and high relative speed creates energy: small body slows modestly 42.0->38.3 m/s while large body reverses and accelerates 16.3->51.8 m/s, total mechanical energy jumps 3712->23651 J in one step (6 substeps) with no controller work. Even e=0 still gains 3712->12492 J. Removing the collision (shifting x) conserves energy. Indicates impulse application bugs - wrong mass factor or velocity update adding kinetic energy.
